title: Two Birds One Stone: Effective Static Detection of Resource and Communication Deadlocks in Rust Programs
abstract: arXiv:2401.01114v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Although Rust claims to enable fearless concurrency, concurrency errors remain prevalent in practical applications, with deadlocks particularly prominent and harmful. Current static deadlock detection techniques either do not cater to Rust programs without incorporating Rust semantics or solely concentrate on resource deadlocks, disregarding communication deadlocks. In this paper, we present RcChecker, the first static detection method that simultaneously targets resource and communication deadlocks for Rust. At its core, RcChecker introduces the signal-lock graph to characterize the interactions between threads through lock variables and condition variables. The construction of the signal-lock graph involves utilizing flow-sensitive and context-sensitive analyses to track variable lifetime details and abstracting actions associated with condition variables into signal resource holdings and requests. translated_title: 一石二鸟：Rust程序中资源死锁与通信死锁的高效静态检测
translated_abstract: 尽管Rust声称能够实现“无惧并发”，但在实际应用中，并发错误仍然普遍存在，其中死锁问题尤为突出且危害巨大。当前的静态死锁检测技术要么因未融合Rust语义而无法适用于Rust程序，要么仅专注于资源死锁而忽略了通信死锁。本文提出了RcChecker，这是首个能够同时针对Rust资源死锁和通信死锁的静态检测方法。其核心在于引入信号-锁图来刻画线程之间通过锁变量和条件变量进行的交互。信号-锁图的构建包括利用流敏感和上下文敏感分析来跟踪变量生命周期的细节，并将与条件变量相关的操作抽象为信号资源的持有和请求。通过检查图中的环……
tldr: 本文提出首个能同时检测Rust程序中资源死锁与通信死锁的静态检测工具RcChecker，通过新颖的信号-锁图刻画线程间经由锁变量和条件变量的交互，实现有效检测。
en_tdlr: RcChecker is the first static detection method that simultaneously targets both resource and communication deadlocks in Rust programs, introducing a novel signal-lock graph to characterize thread interactions through lock and condition variables.
